headline: Watch: Iran says Hormuz stays shut and Houthi missiles are now targeting Riyadh, keeping fuel the main risk for SA; nothing changed locally.
summary: Iran has denied it is in talks with the US and says the Strait of Hormuz will stay shut until its demands are met, while Saudi Arabia intercepted three Houthi cruise missiles fired at Riyadh after an earlier strike damaged an Aramco building there. Brent oil rose about 1.7% to US$93 and the Australian dollar fell 1%, which together push SA fuel prices up. Overnight GPS jamming over the Persian Gulf fits the ongoing conflict; no new US or Iranian strikes were confirmed. In SA, fire danger is Moderate in the Hills with no bans or warnings.
